title: B7G knowledge file
description: Canonical format for knowledge/*.json files ingested by `npm run rag:ingest`. Markdown files with frontmatter are converted into the same shape.

id.description: Stable id. Defaults to <file>/<slug of title>. Keep it stable so updates replace the old version.

category.description: Free-form. Known: event, chief_guest, guest, biography, programme, performer, sponsor, venue, schedule, faq, kannada_rajyotsava, karnataka_history, karnataka_culture, heritage, b7g_community, announcement, gallery, general.

entity_type.description: e.g. person, group, organisation, event, place

entity_name.description: Canonical name, e.g. "Prakash Belawadi". Enables entity-aware retrieval.

aliases.description: Other names people may type: nicknames, misspellings, Kannada script, related titles.

is_active.description: Set false to retire outdated information without deleting it.

content.description: Plain text or Markdown. "## " headings split it into sections.
